every_number_computed_twice: Each count was found by two independent routes - one factored, one expanded by the distributive law, which rounds twice where the first rounds once. Where they disagreed nothing was published at all.
the_four_questions: How many panels fit in one row; what happens if you add one more; how much colder it can get before that row stops working; and whether the answer can be defended by pointing at a document.
this_is_not_engineering: It describes whether a row of panels sits inside a published equipment rating. It is not a connection offer, not a constructability assessment and not a consenting design. Engineering carries the name of a responsible engineer, and nothing here does.
what_is_not_here: Two of the four limits this estate measures against trace to no document, and one of those two is the same test as a third once its constant is halved. No answer above rests on either. Current is a separate question from the count above and is not answered here.
what_this_is: Every answer, worked out in advance. The page that shows these does no arithmetic: it looks them up. A lookup table cannot have a bug in its engine, because it has no engine - which is why this is the form the work is left in.
